page_note: Page contains the Five Fathers cosmological teaching (specifically Fourth = Mind of Light with three powers, and Fifth = form of light at death with three angels of prize/garment/crown), followed by chapter heading VIII and the opening of the Four Mounts teaching. Substrate is dominant in cosmological enumeration. Editorial seams: institutional language (elect/catechumens, churches, faithful) is woven into the Mind of Light section — these are pointer-references that pull the cosmic mapping into the editor's church world. The chapter heading and dialogue formula 'Again the Man of Light speaks' (seg 29, seam-flagged) clearly mark editorial framework. The death-vision schema (form of light + 3 angels with prize/garment/crown) is rich substrate inheritance from Iranian eschatology (cf. daēnā).
